c4e35e2772863c5998fd35a546a2@global-arts.description: In her practice, Dayanita Singh experiments with form through photography, architecture, and books to create exhibitions. Using these mediums, Singh extends an invitation to audiences to question how books, and book-making, might transform a space into an exhibition. This show takes cues from Singh’s artist-led approach to exhibitions to explore the relationship between “making” and “reading.” With Singh’s Book Building (2022) as a blueprint, this exhibition analyzes book-making as an artistic practice, material form, and conceptual process. 0e60731e5ec4b6c5245d96eab9f6@global-arts.title: Claiming the Sea: Asian Perspectives on Maritime Dominance
0e60731e5ec4b6c5245d96eab9f6@global-arts.description: Asia’s seas have long served as arenas of commerce, cooperation, contestation, and conflict. Today, the maritime expanse stretching from the Indian Ocean to the Arctic stands at the center of global geopolitics, economic flows, environmental pressures, and strategic competition—military, legal, and otherwise. With these dynamics in mind, this conference seeks to foster interdisciplinary dialogue on how maritime dominance is conceptualized, pursued, and contested across Asian contexts. 3043fb04b8868f1669be8fe65ee2@global-arts.title: Movie Screening: Breaking the West
3043fb04b8868f1669be8fe65ee2@global-arts.description: In the 2010s, Western documentary filmmakers gained access to a Russian real-estate oligarch, Aras Agalarov, and his son, Emin. From this they made the film, Breaking the West, which explores the story of the Agalarov family and its ties to countries outside of Russia, including the United States. After screening this film, Peter Baker, Susan Glasser, Bridget Hunnicutt and Michael Kimmage will discuss its core themes, from kleptocracy in Russia to international patterns of corruption and influence peddling - past and present. .

6dc5f63aaf4357161fb8356d09dc@global-arts.description: Join the GW Department of American Studies for part one of our 2026-27 Mergen-Palmer Distinguished Lecture Series featuring Prof. Justin Mann, associate professor of English at Northwestern University, and a GW American Studies PhD alum. “Getting Lost in the Dark” analyzes two texts, Victor La Valle and Dietrich Smith’s graphic novel Destroyer and the Russo brothers' Captain America: The Winter Soldier , to show how Black speculative fictions reimagine the possibilities, limits, and potential ends of the American security state.

4cd3f0e53676b8a6787f011eb4a1@global-arts.title: Humanities in Asia: Going Beyond Make-Do-the Reshaping of a Chinese Operatic Tradition in Taiwan
4cd3f0e53676b8a6787f011eb4a1@global-arts.description: Kunqu, a 600-year-old form of Chinese opera known for its poetic lyrics and refined singing, was among the first Chinese art forms UNESCO recognized as a "Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity" in 2001. The story of how Kunqu survived the political upheavals of the twentieth century runs not only through state-sponsored troupes in China but also through communities of devoted amateur singers, known as quyou (曲友), who carried the tradition to Taiwan. This talk follows these enthusiasts from their roots in Mainland China to their postwar lives in Taiwan, where they kept Kunqu alive through informal singing gatherings long before it was celebrated as world heritage. 21d333444878ec23f0a8099daea9@global-arts.title: Exhibit | Centering Philippine and Filipinx American Histories: Selections from The Bancroft Library
21d333444878ec23f0a8099daea9@global-arts.description: The Bancroft Library’s collections of materials relating to the Philippines span nearly 500 years. Highlights in this exhibit include a transcript of an Inquisitorial trial from 1646, a prayer book written in the Cebuano language, and UC Berkeley Filipino student publications from 1905 to the present. The exhibit also features selections from the personal papers of acclaimed author Jessica Hagedorn, including typewritten drafts of her novels, poetry, song lyrics, and a screenplay, as well as childhood drawings and writings. Open hours may vary. Please view the The Bancroft Library hours page for the most up-to-date information.

fb8e456fcb19710c29d2e79fd528@global-arts.address: The Rowell Exhibition Cases, Doe Library, 2nd floor
fb8e456fcb19710c29d2e79fd528@global-arts.description: In 1985, UC Berkeley students, with support from faculty, staff, and labor unions, transformed the campus into the heart of a powerful anti-apartheid divestment campaign. bf0a98eaa0560415ad69b679085f@global-arts.description: Pour a glass of wine and you’re tasting more than grapes. You’re tasting geography. 3fd7b08ba947a822ff2ef5334972@global-arts.description: Flamboyants! is a music and theater show that brings together three places with a shared history: New Orleans, Puerto Rico and Réunion Island, a French island in the Indian Ocean. It blends live music, theater and documentary storytelling to explore how these Creole communities, shaped by colonization and slavery, kept their cultures alive through music, language and celebration. 3507dea2c4f93c02ee3395dfb394@global-arts.description: With Amanda Banks & Saudade Toxosi Coffee is one of the most traded commodities in the world. Its supply chain touches nearly every continent and carries a long, complicated history of land, labor, and extraction. Artist Amanda Banks has spent time tracing her own family’s connection to that history. The burlap sacks she latch-hooks aren’t just reclaimed materials. They’re a way of working through what she’s learned, stitch by stitch. In this hands-on workshop, Banks will teach participants basic latch-hook techniques using reclaimed coffee sacks and recycled yarn. d65f840b3a6ef05d5f48e7fdeb22@global-arts.description: Marcia Wood Gallery is pleased to present “Emerald Tears”, a solo exhibition of new paintings by Atlanta-based artist Kim Ouellette. This is Ouellette’s third solo exhibition with the gallery. Her absorbing paintings are sought after for their lush color, tactile surfaces, and polyphonic compositions. The title comes from a chance discovery: while working with a new emerald green paint, Ouellette came across “Emerald Tears”, Dave Holland’s solo bass album. Its melancholy, she says, connects to the mood of the new paintings, where the green returns like a single voice moving through a space. 6071961e736891aa78ab6e71821d@global-arts.description: By the end of the 17th century, a growing middle class created a demand for musical and theatrical productions, while the availability of sheet music and instruments in shops resulted in a more musically-literate society. Lauda Baroque will perform selections by Henry Purcell, John Blow, and George Frideric Handel—three of the central figures in 17th and 18th century England—while also paying homage to other composers who helped bring music to the masses. 4de1269babcd2c497789c81cd934@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

992ec34aa57daa004800cba02648@global-arts.title: Make @ MODA: Handmade Altars
992ec34aa57daa004800cba02648@global-arts.description: Join us for MAKE @ MODA: Handmade Altars, a hands-on workshop exploring the art and design of altars. Altars have been part of art and design across cultures for centuries. People have used them to honor others, preserve memories, express beliefs, and tell stories. Their design often brings together meaningful objects and imagery to create a space with purpose. During the workshop, you’ll design and build your own small handmade altar. We’ll explore how color, symbolism, composition, and layering can help communicate an idea. You’ll work with paper, collage materials, flowers, found objects, and decorative elements to bring your design to life.

ade7e81b30f12d55b5fc3f5bc91b@global-arts.description: Set out as an explorer into a world only you can chart. Enchanted Map of Me is a guided art and self-discovery workshop that invites you to follow the contours of your inner life: the experiences that shaped you, the values that guide you, and the hopes still taking form. Through reflection, drawing, painting, symbolism, and storytelling, you’ll give this landscape shape on paper, discovering its connections and leaving room for what remains unknown. It poignantly examines not only what happened but more importantly, the lives of the girls killed and the lives of those left behind. “Only a filmmaker so resourceful, so entirely confident in his practiced craft, could have made such a quilt out of patches of nightmare and nostalgia – of gospels, ghosts, and grief. 3a4fd90693161dfb64076dd18a6b@global-arts.title: The Dynamic! – Funny scenes, songs and games!
3a4fd90693161dfb64076dd18a6b@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

Join MODA’s Queer Figure Drawing Night with Ashanti Hampton for Queer Across Generations, a special session celebrating queer bodies across time. For this gathering, we’ll welcome a queer elder as our model and make space to consider the beauty, complexity, and possibility of aging. 857cb92a9fa83c2e04f8d0e817d1@global-arts.description: In this virtual studio, young designers will explore how museums use graphic design to present historical information through exhibition graphics, labels, and promotional displays. Students will invent an ancient civilization or forgotten city, develop its history and culture. They’ll use Canva to create a poster or artifact label that introduces visitors to their discovery. They will combine typography, illustrations, symbols, maps, and historical details to create a design that feels both educational and imaginative. At the end of the studio, students can share their work and receive feedback in a supportive environment.

789d87b82b79a2ec0d20a56e5911@global-arts.description: Silent Night is the powerful, true account of the spontaneous Christmas truce between French, British, and German soldiers during World War I. Based on the film “Joyeux Noël,” the story takes place on Christmas Eve, the opposing forces lay down their weapons, come together around a makeshift tree to sing carols, and play soccer matches. The soldiers’ peaceful actions are reprimanded by their commanders, but cast a lasting light on the goodness of humanity in the face of war. 59891ef23041377735fce05486e7@global-arts.title: The Dynamic! – Funny scenes, songs and games!
59891ef23041377735fce05486e7@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

f1c42b5ca65862d45e8f1b318dba@global-arts.description: Silent Night is the powerful, true account of the spontaneous Christmas truce between French, British, and German soldiers during World War I. Based on the film “Joyeux Noël,” the story takes place on Christmas Eve, the opposing forces lay down their weapons, come together around a makeshift tree to sing carols, and play soccer matches. The soldiers’ peaceful actions are reprimanded by their commanders, but cast a lasting light on the goodness of humanity in the face of war. Artistic Director Tomer Zvulun will direct, and Principal Conductor Iván López Reynoso will conduct. d6bd12ba9c4057e4a0d9b6b1986c@global-arts.title: The Dynamic! – Funny scenes, songs and games!
d6bd12ba9c4057e4a0d9b6b1986c@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

d88b37252bcc19bff1bbf47134c4@global-arts.description: TRAD is a theatrical tear-down of the modern “trad wife” phenomenon and the Christian nationalist beliefs behind it, which also indulges our collective yearning for fantasies of escape. This trad wife is eternally pregnant and endlessly devout: what could shake the ripeness of her faith? Staged as a seminar for women curious about the tradwife life, with the audience cast as the attendees. Expect to be called on. Written and performed by Hannah Mitchell. Directed by Iris McCloughan. Initially co-directed and devised with Meaghan Robichaud. Produced by Celebration Barn. 3a5a8ce724cb69c705212e2c5b40@global-arts.address: 572 Edgewood Ave SE, Suite 116, Atlanta, GA, 30312
3a5a8ce724cb69c705212e2c5b40@global-arts.description: New work from an award-winning idiot. Join Beth Anne (a woman!), a middle-aged beauty queen (almost!), who has spent her life shape-shifting into what she thinks others want, only to realize she doesn’t know herself at all. She looks for her reflection in Medusa, the Sirens of The Odyssey, and the Weird Sisters of Macbeth. These misunderstood women pull her through the wreckage of her past, forcing her to confront the stories she’s been told about what it means to be beautiful, desirable, good and worthy. In a wild, theatrical unraveling, Beth Anne is ripped open and reborn as something powerful, ferocious and entirely her own. Written and performed by Julia VanderVeen. Directed by Jess Laza

f2a2d9b4ce4ec27c6fd1b46e82e9@global-arts.title: 37th New Orleans Film Fest
f2a2d9b4ce4ec27c6fd1b46e82e9@global-arts.description: The New Orleans Film Festival (NOFF) presented by Andscape, organized by the New Orleans Film Society, is a renowned celebration of independent filmmaking that has been championing diverse voices and groundbreaking stories for over 37 years. As an Academy Award®-qualifying festival in the categories of Documentary Short, Narrative Short, and Animated Short, NOFF serves as a vital platform for emerging and established filmmakers to showcase their work to global audiences.

cfdacd82a223a4829ef87f2bf589@global-arts.title: Street Theater featuring Robert Rufino
cfdacd82a223a4829ef87f2bf589@global-arts.description: A story from The Current, featuring legendary design editor Robert Rufino, Street Theater offers a look at his early work creating some of New York’s most memorable window displays. From fashion to luxury design, Rufino brought an inventive and theatrical approach to visual presentation that helped transform the storefront into a creative medium of its own. The film reflects on an influential chapter in New York design and the imagination, artistry, and sense of spectacle behind Rufino’s work.

9391f1c4ad10d5e09d96fa6bbfa1@global-arts.title: Great Scott! The Life/Work of Carol Scott
9391f1c4ad10d5e09d96fa6bbfa1@global-arts.description: A landmark solo exhibition, “Great Scott,” will showcase more than 40 of Scott’s past and current works across various media, celebrating her significant contributions to visual art in New Orleans. Moreover, it will be the first full retrospective of her work presented at a major New Orleans cultural institution.

0d98b77a6200c5a72c9c485178d5@global-arts.title: Nic[o] Brierre Aziz: Sweet Surrender
0d98b77a6200c5a72c9c485178d5@global-arts.description: Nic[o] Brierre Aziz: "Sweet Surrender" is the Haitian-New Orleanian artist’s first institutional solo exhibition, and surveys a range of works in performance, photography, sculpture, and installation created over the last ten years. Whether turning to Southern antebellum history or contemporary art markets, Aziz’s work interrogates the de/valuation of Black life and cultural heritage, both exposing and subverting systems of cultural, political, and economic power.

0a5b12c3c14496187edd553b580c@global-arts.title: PULSE: School of the Damned

614c38f460fb72849b06ae75c6ea@global-arts.description: One of the most important filmmakers to emerge from Japan’s post-war era, Imamura’s unruly, inventive, and often anthropological approach to cinema is singular in the medium’s history.

c515205d4cde1af70c910e6a9e79@global-arts.description: London genre-defying trio, PVA, join our October In the Round series, presenting a special performance of  A Dream Like This , their new EP, reimagined with cello and harp. Support from Rosemary Moss.

d01586fcdb47497b5938b169f439@global-arts.description: The inaugural ICA Makers Market brings together local artists, designers and independent makers for a day of seasonal shopping, gift-buying and mulled wine.

191770aaf3b0f83b0970dc04fdf4@global-arts.title: Silver
191770aaf3b0f83b0970dc04fdf4@global-arts.description: A casi 5.000 metros de altura, la vida en Cerro Rico gira alrededor de una mina que da sustento y, al mismo tiempo, amenaza a quienes dependen de ella. A través de la mirada de Juvi, un niño de doce años, Silver se acerca con enorme intimidad a una comunidad marcada por el trabajo extremo, la espiritualidad y una herencia extractiva que atraviesa generaciones. Con una fotografía poderosa y una mirada observacional, la película nos enfrenta al coste humano de un modelo que sigue midiendo la riqueza por todo aquello que somos capaces de extraer de la tierra. > Estreno en España. > Coloquio posterior con Erika González Briz , Coordinación Confederación de Ecologistas en Acción.

c27ffb3a3705b8b5ff127abe6b64@global-arts.title: Christiania
c27ffb3a3705b8b5ff127abe6b64@global-arts.description: Christiania es uno de los experimentos comunitarios más singulares de Europa: una comuna autogestionada que durante más de cinco décadas ha intentado construir una forma de vida basada en la libertad, la creatividad y la democracia por consenso. A través de un extraordinario archivo y una mirada cercana y llena de humor, el documental recorre sus ideales, tensiones y transformaciones, preguntándose hasta qué punto una comunidad puede cambiar para sobrevivir sin renunciar a aquello que la hizo única. > Estreno en España. > Coloquio posterior con Pablo Carmona , Programador de Nociones Comunes en Traficantes de Sueños y miembro del consejo de redacción de Zona de Estrategia.

d9ec5a8749bde9f4dde24a38fb67@global-arts.title: Elements of(f) Balance
d9ec5a8749bde9f4dde24a38fb67@global-arts.description: Elements of(f) Balance nos invita a adentrarnos en ecosistemas apenas explorados que emergen entre las ruinas de un modelo basado en la explotación de la naturaleza. Lejos de plantear una visión distópica del futuro, el documental dirige la mirada hacia otras formas posibles de habitar el mundo: relaciones basadas en la interdependencia, la cooperación y la recuperación de vínculos que parecían olvidados. Una película que propone repensar nuestra relación con el entorno y descubrir, en medio de la crisis ecológica, nuevas posibilidades de equilibrio entre los seres humanos y los ecosistemas de los que formamos parte. > Estreno en España. > Coloquio posterior con Gonzalo Anguita , Director ej

708b78264c75c50e21dc05e206e7@global-arts.title: Vanishing Tracks
708b78264c75c50e21dc05e206e7@global-arts.description: En Irán, Valiollah y Dorna viven los últimos años de una existencia nómada amenazada por la sedentarización y por un mundo que cambia demasiado deprisa. Mientras sus hijos miran hacia la ciudad, ellos intentan mantener un vínculo con el territorio, el rebaño y una forma de vida heredada durante generaciones. El robo de parte de sus animales acentúa una distancia que ya estaba creciendo. Íntimo y contemplativo, el documental reflexiona sobre todo aquello que se pierde cuando el progreso rompe los lazos entre comunidad, memoria y paisaje. > Estreno en Madrid

824018102b5b6c33adeed07579a9@global-arts.title: Super Nature
824018102b5b6c33adeed07579a9@global-arts.description: Filmado íntegramente en Super 8 por colaboradores de 25 países, Super Nature compone una carta de amor al planeta que celebra nuestra conexión con la naturaleza y nos invita a mirar de nuevo todo aquello que podemos perder. > Estreno en España. > Coloquio posterior con Luis Suárez , Coordinador del Departamento de Conservación de WWF España.

049d7aa20edacb512918c3198a49@global-arts.title: Power Station
049d7aa20edacb512918c3198a49@global-arts.description: ¿Puede una calle cualquiera convertirse en el inicio de una revolución energética? En Walthamstow, dos artistas convencen a sus vecinos para transformar sus tejados en una central solar comunitaria. Entre obstáculos, campañas disparatadas, humor y mucha perseverancia, Power Station convierte la transición energética en una aventura colectiva, cercana y contagiosa. Un retrato lleno de optimismo sobre el poder de la comunidad, la creatividad y la acción local para ampliar los límites de lo que creemos posible. > Estreno en España. > Coloquio posterior con Brezo Díaz-Rubín , Ingeniera de la energía, especializada en instalaciones eléctricas, autoconsumo solar fotovoltaico, eficiencia energética

b0d2b5aebb6e104bb72dbd36e4e4@global-arts.title: A Life Illuminated
b0d2b5aebb6e104bb72dbd36e4e4@global-arts.description: A Life Illuminated nos acerca a la figura de la pionera bióloga marina Edie Widder y a una vida dedicada a explorar aquello que el océano todavía oculta. Sus investigaciones sobre la bioluminiscencia y las profundidades marinas revelan un mundo tan extraordinario como vulnerable. A través de la ciencia, el asombro y unas imágenes excepcionales, la película nos invita a comprender mejor estos ecosistemas y a reconocer que proteger lo desconocido también forma parte de proteger el futuro del planeta. > Estreno en España. > Coloquio posterior con Aida Verdes Gorín , Investigadora Ramón y Cajal.

1c932d87e9dd14824b408d15f005@global-arts.title: Hijas del Bosque
1c932d87e9dd14824b408d15f005@global-arts.description: En los bosques de México, dos micólogas indígenas se adentran en el fascinante universo de los hongos, donde saberes ancestrales y ciencia contemporánea se encuentran. Hijas del bosque es una experiencia cautivadora, tierna y sorprendente que combina documental, ciencia y especulación para descubrir las conexiones invisibles que sostienen la vida. Un viaje sensorial y casi mágico que invita a mirar la naturaleza de otra manera y a imaginar futuros basados en el cuidado, la interdependencia y la colaboración entre especies. > Estreno en España > Previamente a la proyección, tendrá lugar la clausura y entrega de premios del festival (30' aprox.)

c92005ffb93f888082cf57b65980@global-arts.title: Durmiendo con lobos
c92005ffb93f888082cf57b65980@global-arts.description: Durante cinco años, Andoni Canela y su hija Amaia comparten un mismo sueño: ver lobos en libertad. Entre montañas, noches bajo las estrellas y mucha paciencia, descubrirán que encontrar al lobo es solo el principio. Un viaje para comprender que el futuro del lobo es también el futuro de nuestros bosques y montañas. > Apta para todos los públicos

d63a90470a56666be09a5f55ded5@global-arts.title: Los sueños que compartimos
d63a90470a56666be09a5f55ded5@global-arts.description: ¿Qué tendría que ocurrir para que en 2050 hubiéramos conseguido frenar el deterioro del planeta? Desde ese futuro posible, Los sueños que compartimos mira hacia las luchas que ya están transformando el presente. A partir del viaje transatlántico de comunidades mayas zapatistas, Valentina Leduc conecta resistencias de México, España y Alemania que defienden sus territorios frente a la destrucción industrial. Un relato colectivo sobre organización, solidaridad y cuidado de la vida que imagina la utopía no como un sueño lejano, sino como algo que empieza a construirse hoy. > Estreno en Madrid. > Coloquio posterior con Fernanda Fernández , productora en secciones de información internacional y c

da48cd39dd35791d13ea6ce1380c@global-arts.title: Yanuni
da48cd39dd35791d13ea6ce1380c@global-arts.description: En la Amazonia brasileña, la líder indígena Juma Xipaia lleva años defendiendo su territorio frente a la minería ilegal, la violencia y los intereses que amenazan la selva. Yanuni acompaña de cerca una lucha que es política, ambiental y profundamente personal, especialmente cuando la maternidad introduce una nueva dimensión de futuro. Íntima y urgente, la película conecta la defensa de los pueblos indígenas con la protección de uno de los ecosistemas esenciales del planeta y recuerda que cuidar la Amazonia es también decidir qué mundo dejamos a quienes vienen detrás.na verdad incómoda: no se puede salvar la naturaleza destruyendo la naturaleza. > Estreno en Madrid. > Coloquio posterior con J

5782db8c21350bca23fcf5c321cb@global-arts.title: Because of Who They Were, We Are
5782db8c21350bca23fcf5c321cb@global-arts.description: Closing event of the project Where is my friends______? and presentation of the photobook dummy resulting from a research process on the memories and archives of the Chinese community. Through a conversation with interviewees and project participants, an open space will be created to share stories and experiences, and to continue building a living archive that connects territories, generations, and ways of inhabiting space, both within and beyond Usera. Participants Yuan iuan is a Chinese migrant, anti-racist queer activist, and visual artist specializing in spatial design. 4895402c3deb52a9e45895cdc833@global-arts.title: A Conversation with Mariana Enríquez

Featuring guest speaker Ismael Martínez Biurrun. Organized by: Editorial Páginas de Espuma and Escuela de Escritores.

193451d160dc6199aa04cac76240@global-arts.title: Curtain Up: En boca de artista 3
193451d160dc6199aa04cac76240@global-arts.description: En boca de artista returns—a series that shines a spotlight on creators and their creative processes. On this occasion, the conversations will focus on the research currently being developed at the CRA by the Art and Environment residents. This first session will explore botany, the language used to classify flowers, and natural history, intersecting these concepts with speculative fiction and archaeologies of the future. The first session will take place on October 29 and will be divided into two parts: Part One: Ignacio García Sánchez and Ana Robles Pérez will begin the session with a conversation alongside artist, educator, and researcher Bárbara Fluxá . Immersed in contemporary speculati

bd4372c6b888af6408d09216816a@global-arts.title: Mitología de barrio + Quién vio los templos caer
bd4372c6b888af6408d09216816a@global-arts.description: Las ciudades, lejos de retóricas tradicionalistas, identitarias, exotizantes o romantizadoras, son, por el contrario, espacios, igual que cualquier otro, para el control y la dominación, espacios de ordenación del territorio y de las personas. Las películas, lejos también de retóricas autocomplacientes, son resultado y consecuencia de la época y las contradicciones que nos rodean. Quién vio los templos caer y Mitología de barrio son dos películas realizadas en paralelo, sin comunicarse entre sí ni conocerse durante dicho proceso. Sin embargo, los puntos en común, tanto en lo formal como en sus contenidos, son seguramente inevitables, pero sobre todo interesantes o propicios para una conversa

97d80ff7d770d454d5b31df51419@global-arts.title: Gatos encaramados
97d80ff7d770d454d5b31df51419@global-arts.description: Tras el 11 de septiembre, un gato amarillo dibujado comienza a aparecer en los muros de París, observando la ciudad con una enigmática sonrisa. Intrigado por esta figura, Chris Marker emprende un viaje visual y reflexivo a través de la capital francesa, explorando el arte urbano, las protestas sociales y el estado del mundo en un tiempo de incertidumbre. Chats perchés es una meditación poética sobre la memoria colectiva, la resistencia y la belleza inesperada en medio del caos. > Coloquio posterior con los arquitectos Aritz González y David García-Asenjo

c45a9ecd5cf31f52b6eab646ca5e@global-arts.title: Crossroads. El viaje circular de Boa Mistura
c45a9ecd5cf31f52b6eab646ca5e@global-arts.description: La periferia de Ciudad del Cabo, Sudáfrica, es el epicentro de un inspirador viaje a través del trabajo de Boa Mistura, colectivo artístico de proyección internacional con raíces en el graffiti y el arte urbano. En el camino, el arte urbano se convierte en el vehículo que conecta las vidas de un vecino de una favela en São Paulo, un joven del slum de Kibera, en Kenia, una indígena mapuche en el norte de Chile, un refugiado sirio y una mujer de una población pesquera de República Dominicana. Estos pequeños encuentros a través de la pintura son la semilla de cambios tanto en los vecinos de las comunidades como en el colectivo. > Encuentro posterior con los artistas de Boa Mistura.

4ca43d5d817dc91e3f7c894ba84d@global-arts.description: Rompemos el mito: ¡tejer a dos agujas está al alcance de cualquiera! 57945af87681e6738dc4435ddfcd@global-arts.title: GANCHILLO INTERMEDIO ‘A TODO GANCHO: MARIPOSAS VIOLETAS'
57945af87681e6738dc4435ddfcd@global-arts.description: Itziar Prats presentará «El Latido de las Mariposas», un proyecto educativo y social que utiliza la creación colectiva de mariposas violetas como herramienta de sensibilización y educación para promover una sociedad más igualitaria, respetuosa y libre de violencia de género. 5381b658ae901c8734522ab2f102@global-arts.title: Lali Ayguadé Company
5381b658ae901c8734522ab2f102@global-arts.description: The show primarily explores the stark contrast between the virtual world—including artificial intelligence and social networks—and the authentic reality of our everyday lives. This dichotomy is depicted through a nuanced interplay of revelation and concealment, examining the façade we present online versus our concealed true selves. While we often portray a façade of positivity in digital spaces, the show delves into the hidden negativity of our reality that we typically choose to keep private. 95c09ccbeaae60335a6d0b3422e4@global-arts.title: Presentation: Cosamala, by Alana S. Portero
95c09ccbeaae60335a6d0b3422e4@global-arts.description: Andalusia, 1937. The Carranza column—composed of horsemen, bullfighters, Falangists, landowners, and Civil Guards—advances through the northern mountains of Seville, subjugating everything in its path and drenching the land in blood, like Death riding across the fields. A group of women—wives, mothers, and neighbors of fugitives and the persecuted—initiate themselves in the dark language as a form of resistance, forming a coven with the goal of bringing life back to an infertile country with the help of their dead and ghosts. 411847c701029293a0aa608837c9@global-arts.title: Exposición gráfica 'Súper Letras'
411847c701029293a0aa608837c9@global-arts.description: Las letras sirven para escribir. Claro. Pero también se pueden dibujar, deformar, romper, fotografiar, construir, recortar, pintar o llevar hasta lugares donde casi dejan de parecer letras. De eso va Súper Letras. Una exposición que saca letras y números de su sitio habitual para convertirlos en materia gráfica. Tipografía experimental, lettering, caligrafía, ilustración, collage, fotografía, composición gráfica y otras formas de trabajar desde el lenguaje gráfico contemporáneo. La regla es sencilla: un carácter. Nada más. Sin palabras que lo acompañen. Sin una frase que explique lo que estamos viendo. de9c4f3a84643c29a225b70b19ec@global-arts.title: Presentación de 'Cosamala', de Alana S. Portero
de9c4f3a84643c29a225b70b19ec@global-arts.description: Andalucía, 1937. La columna Carranza, formada por caballistas, toreros, falangistas, terratenientes y Guardias Civiles, avanza por la sierra norte de Sevilla subyugando todo a su paso y empachando la tierra de sangre, como la muerte cabalgando por los campos. Un grupo de mujeres, esposas, madres y vecinas de huidos y perseguidos se inician en el lenguaje oscuro como forma de resistencia y forman un aquelarre con el objetivo de devolver la vida a un país infértil con la ayuda de sus muertos y fantasmas. 57ecce79c3845305ae59890688fa@global-arts.description: ¿Y si pudiéramos ver bailar un cuento? ¿Y si pudiéramos darle voz, cuerpo, música y movimiento? d3ff04e8e6267dfcf5ea48a46f27@global-arts.description: ¿Puede la inteligencia artificial leer, escribir y crear como nosotros? ¿Qué sigue siendo exclusivamente humano? En el marco del Festival Somos Lectura 2026, reunimos a distintas voces para explorar la relación entre inteligencia artificial, lectura y escritura. Una conversación abierta y estimulante sobre cómo están cambiando nuestra forma de crear, interpretar y compartir historias, y sobre el papel que seguimos desempeñando las personas en un mundo cada vez más mediado por algoritmos. Porque la tecnología puede poner las palabras, pero el sentido, la mirada crítica y la emoción siguen abriendo preguntas que merecen ser compartidas. 1283cb423eee415546f3e4c65884@global-arts.description: ¡El secreto de la magia debe ser protegido! Algo raro está pasando en la Mansión Inocente. Inocencio Inocente jura que solo eran bromas, pero la Agencia de Brujería sospecha que hay magia prohibida de por medio. Alguien tiene que investigar y descubrir la verdad antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Ese alguien sois vosotros. Durante esta partida os convertís en agentes secretos de la Agencia: reunís pistas, interrogáis sospechosos y descubrís, todos juntos, qué ha pasado de verdad en esa mansión. No hace falta haber jugado antes a rol: las reglas son mínimas, y en cinco minutos ya habréis creado vuestro personaje y estaréis metidos en la historia, dado en mano y varita lista. eeace713cfec66c5d72eacbcc153@global-arts.description: ¿Crees que lo sabes todo sobre Pokémon? La franquicia empezó siendo un videojuego, pero con el paso de los años, generación tras generación ha tenido la oportunidad de disfrutar de los personajes creados por Satoshi Tajiri en otros formatos. ¿Cómo empezó todo? ¿Qué libros tienen como protagonista a este universo? ¿En qué consisten los juegos electrónicos en los que compiten equipos especializados? Todas las respuestas en esta charla en la que, además, tendrás oportunidad de conocer a uno de los jugadores más famosos de esta especialidad (Alex "PokéAlex" Gómez).

0ec89dbd2c1d506d152253c14111@global-arts.title: Let Our Mountains Live
0ec89dbd2c1d506d152253c14111@global-arts.description: En las montañas de Noruega, uno de los mayores proyectos eólicos de Europa amenaza las tierras de pastoreo de las que dependen las comunidades sami y su cultura ancestral. Aunque el Tribunal Supremo reconoce que la instalación vulnera sus derechos, las turbinas permanecen. Let Our Mountains Live acompaña su lucha frente al Estado y plantea una incómoda paradoja: ¿puede construirse una transición verde sacrificando a quienes llevan generaciones protegiendo el territorio? Un relato sobre justicia climática, poder y resistencia indígena. > Estreno en España > Coloquio posterior con Rosa Pardo , profesora en el departamento de Historia Contemporánea en la UNED y colaboradora de ALIENTE.

9b4667e33e716f04609c249714d1@global-arts.title: La Pietà
9b4667e33e716f04609c249714d1@global-arts.description: En una remota granja al pie del mayor glaciar de Islandia, los recuerdos de una familia se entrelazan con un paisaje que está desapareciendo. A través de fotografías, voces y una poderosa memoria íntima, La Pietà convierte el retroceso del hielo en una historia sobre el paso del tiempo, la pérdida y nuestra relación con la naturaleza. Un relato bello y conmovedor que nos recuerda que, cuando un paisaje desaparece, también se desvanece parte de la memoria de quienes aprendieron a vivir junto a él. > Estreno en Madrid > Coloquio posterior con Rafa Molès y Pepe Andreu , directores, guionistas y productores en SUICAfilms.

7c954aab445d62323150b596c697@global-arts.title: Of Mud and Blood
7c954aab445d62323150b596c697@global-arts.description: En las montañas del Congo, Numbi parece estar lejos de nuestro mundo, pero guarda bajo tierra uno de los minerales que lo mantienen conectado. Allí, hombres y mujeres extraen coltán a mano, atrapados entre la precariedad, los intereses económicos y un conflicto que se alimenta de esa riqueza. Of Mud and Blood se sumerge en su vida cotidiana para revelar el reverso de nuestra comodidad digital y plantearnos una pregunta incómoda: ¿qué parte de este sistema nos corresponde cuando encendemos cada día nuestros dispositivos? > Estreno en Madrid > Coloquio posterior con Nicole Ndongala , Directora General de la Asociación Karibu.

298bedecf110087d6473f14df1f1@global-arts.title: The Dynamic! – Funny scenes, songs and games!
298bedecf110087d6473f14df1f1@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

ba573abd3e2650a6fe9facee3f56@global-arts.title: The Dynamic! – Funny scenes, songs and games!
ba573abd3e2650a6fe9facee3f56@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.
